dex.entry: A storm-husk kin that drifted in from the Coldfog Marches: a hollow shell of compressed dark air and residual lightning, still discharging sporadically from inside an empty void-core. A storm made of nothing — the Hollowing's mark on electricity, eerie and unforgettable.

art.silhouette: Tall hollow silhouette like a funnel-cloud with a gap where the centre should be, dark ink-purple swirling walls faintly lit by trapped lightning, jagged trailing tendrils; uneasy void-shape at 48px.
